verdicts.reason: A: the 'Shop the Summer Line' CTA is squeezed into a narrow column and breaks into four lines with one or two words each. The headline wraps to two lines and runs almost into the top and bottom edges, which looks cramped. The logo is tiny and floats on its own, so the three blocks compete instead of reading left to right. B: a clean left-to-right banner, with the logo on the left and the headline stacked over the CTA on the right as one group. Hierarchy and the original's colours are kept. Its flaws are that the logo is oversized compared with the headline and the middle of the banner is a dead gap.
